usedFor: Sales teams use Agile CRM to catch each “New Contact” and “New Deal”, then run “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal” in Agile CRM
bestTemplate.why: A new deal starts a sales conversation, so it can create a task or add a note right away.

watchOut: “New Contact” in Agile CRM is polling, so actions run after a scheduled check and a short delay is normal.
